change: The overflow is identified by its thrown value, not a context pending flag: the guard throws undefined (tag 0) with the reserved odd payload nativeStackOverflowPayload. The stack-overflow-is host op tests only the value; landing pads only restore the saved limit. js-runtime stackGuard.isOverflow replaces pending/clear.

whyPendingWasUnsound.case7: IteratorClose swallows an overflow raised by return() (the throw completion wins); the pending flag survived, so the user's rethrown undefined became a RangeError
whyPendingWasUnsound.case8: an unrelated catch inside a finally block cleared the flag while the overflow unwound, so the outer catch received undefined instead of a RangeError
whyPendingWasUnsound.staleSites: runtime catches that swallow or replace JavaScript-visible errors without a boundary: lowered and runtime IteratorClose, WeakMap/WeakSet/Map constructors, jobRealm (getFunctionRealm), ShadowRealm wrapping

builder: stack-guard-build-stack-image-h-v2.ts.gz (cases 0-4 as in v1, plus 5-8; each case its own LLDB-contained process)

cases.5: JavaScript throw undefined with no overflow is caught as undefined
cases.6: after a recovered overflow, throw undefined is caught as undefined
cases.7: IteratorClose swallows an overflow in return(): the original undefined reaches the catch, and a later throw undefined stays undefined
cases.8: a catch inside finally while the overflow unwinds: the outer catch still receives a RangeError

hostedTypeScriptFixture: tools/verify-hosted-stack-overflow.ts now also asserts that TypeScript catches see the overflow as undefined and that a TypeScript throw of undefined after recovery is caught as undefined; exit 42, verified twice per run, two runs
scope: Codegen emits the prologue check for every compiled function that makes managed calls or has a frame over 4 KiB, in every program: the v164 self-built compiler has 3,055 checked prologues, and threaded workers run the same hosted startup with their own stack and limit. Only the JavaScript RangeError conversion needs a host to install agent.stackGuard; the Test262 native host is the only JavaScript host.
